items.title: Preview draws faded icons and a dark circle over the dial icons (Groups page edit preview); make every preview look exactly like live plus the PREVIEW tag
items.spec:
Owner bug report 2026-10-23 (inputs/qc-05-groups-preview.png; the owner first said DropWatcher, then corrected it to QuickComms). Opening the settings' Groups page, which starts the edit preview, draws the dial and pads wrong:
- every icon looks faded;
- a dark circle sits on top of the dial's wedge icons.
Expected: the preview looks EXACTLY like live mode, with only the PREVIEW tag (the hub label, the pad drag-strip marker) added. The buttons stay disarmed, because nothing sends in a preview, but disarming must not change how they look.

METHOD (superpowers:systematic-debugging; bisect before theorizing).
1. Reproduce headlessly. Build the same group in live mode and in the edit preview (and in Preview as..., and plain Test mode, for comparison), then diff every visual property the render path sets on each wedge and pad button: alpha, desaturation, vertex color, shown overlays/plates/rings/cooldown/flash/dim textures, and IconStyle results.
2. Find where the preview/disarmed/placeholder path diverges from live. Candidates to check, not conclusions: Pad.ArmSlot / SendEngine.Disarm side effects; a 'refused' or 'unavailable' dim state applied to disarmed slots; Dial_Render's DIM path; an IconStyle ring/plate drawn for not-armed slots; the slices' fill drawn over the icon layer (draw layer / sublevel order).
3. If it is a regression, git bisect it on master history with a headless repro, and record the culprit commit.
4. Fix it so that every preview flavor (edit preview, Preview as..., and Test mode if it shares the cause) renders identically to live apart from the PREVIEW / TEST MODE labels, and stays disarmed. Do not change live rendering.
Tests first: a suite case asserting live == preview for the visual properties of a wedge and a pad button, red before the fix.
If you need the owner's settings, read their SavedVariables (QuickComms.lua under the WoW WTF account folder; the repo's docs or CLAUDE.md name where it lives). Never add a temporary harness to the repo.
Ripple: CHANGELOG/Unreleased per the repo's convention, docs/smoke-tests.md (a check mirroring SM-QC-8), test inventory.
Depends on QC-04 only for serial order in this repo; it does not depend on the preview window.
items.verify: a headless live-vs-preview visual-equality case; luacheck 0/0; lua tests/run.lua green
smoke: SM-QC-8: open Settings -> Groups (edit preview), then Preview as -> Dungeon: dial and pad icons look exactly as in live mode (no fading, no dark circle on the dial icons), only the PREVIEW labels added; buttons do not send
